div.div:
Key
S01 Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Education) (P5/I5)
S02 Chief Information Officer (P5/I4)
S03 Academic Registrar (P4/I5)
S04 Faculty Deans (P4/I3)
S05 Students (domestic & international) (P2/I5)
S06 Student Representative Council (SRC) (P3/I4)
S07 Academic staff (P2/I3)
S08 IT Service Desk (P2/I4)
S09 Finance Office (P4/I3)
S10 Privacy Officer (P4/I4)
S11 Accessibility Services (P2/I4)
S12 LMS vendor (P4/I2)
S13 Portal platform vendor (P3/I4)
S14 TEQSA (regulator) (P5/I1)

div.div: What it means: we manage the sponsor, CIO, Registrar and Privacy Officer closely because any of them can stop or change the project (money, architecture, student data, privacy). Students care a lot but don't have much power, so we keep them informed and they get a voice through the SRC.
